left.raw_text: 1. Use of any steroid (intravenous [IV] or oral) with a cumulative dose equivalent to ≥ 1 g of methylprednisolone for the treatment of GO within 3 weeks prior to Screening.

right.raw_text: 2. Use of rituximab, tocilizumab, or any monoclonal antibody for immunomodulation within the past 9 months prior to Baseline.
4. Absolute neutrophil count <1500 cells/mm3 at Screening.

5. Participants with decreased best corrected visual acuity due to optic neuropathy as defined by a decrease in vision of 2 lines on the Snellen chart, new visual field defect, or color defect secondary to optic nerve involvement within the last 6 months at Screening.

left.raw_text: 6. Previous orbital irradiation or surgery for GO.

right.raw_text: 7. Other, more specific exclusion criteria are defined in the protocol
